description: Ordered inbox for .NET 10, EF Core, PostgreSQL and NATS JetStream with transactional handlers, per-key ordering, deduplication, retries and dead-letter storage.
The Bitween adapter contract: the kinds of adapter Bitween runs (handler, mapper, validator, receiver), what it calls on each, and the payloads it exchanges with them.

Fast Dijkstra and A* shortest-path search for graphs with integer node indices. Finds the cheapest path between two nodes, the nearest node matching a condition, or the cheapest paths to every node. Optional weighted A* trades a bounded amount of path quality for speed. No dependencies.
